sn35.108:1.1: kisminnu kho bhikkhave sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa “seyyo’hamasmīti vā hoti, sadiso’hamasmīti vā hoti, hīno’hamasmīti vā hotī”ti.
sn35.108:2.1: bhagavammūlakā no bhante dhammā, bhagavannettikā, bhagavampaṭisaraṇā; sādhu vata bhante bhagavantaṃ yeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho, bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
sn35.108:3.1: cakkhusmiṃ kho bhikkhave sati cakkhuṃ upādāya cakkhuṃ abhinivissa ‘seyyo’hamasmīti vā hoti, sadiso’hamasmīti vā hoti, hīno’hamasmīti vā hoti. sotasmiṃ sati …pe… ghānasmiṃ sati …pe…
sn35.108:3.3: manasmiṃ sati manaṃ upādāya manaṃ abhinivissa “seyyo’hamasmīti vā hoti. sadiso’hamasmīti vā hoti, hīno’hamasmīti vā hoti.
sn35.108:7.1: “yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya seyyo’hamasmīti vā assa, sadiso’hamasmīti vā assa hīno’hamasmīti vā assā”ti.
sn35.108:8.1: no hetaṃ bhante. sotaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti. aniccaṃ bhante …pe… ghānaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti. aniccaṃ bhante …pe…
sn35.108:9.1: aniccā bhante …pe… kāyo nicco vā anicco vāti. anicco bhante …pe…
sn35.108:12.1: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn35.108:14.1: yampanāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya “seyyo‘hamasmīti vā assa, sadisohamasmīti vā assa, hīno’hamasmīti vā assāti.
sn35.108:16.1: evampassaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, sotasmimpi nibbindati, ghānasmimpi nibbindati, jivhāyapi nibbindati, kāyasmimpi nibbindati, manasmimpi nibbindati.
